post.summary: Read a saved target proxy password
post.description: Explicit Session/CSRF disclosure through the registered mTLS target. Requires target protocol v7 and schema28. The source checks the real administrator, active peer and exact target revision both before and after the network read. The target checks its current controller, exact certificate authorization, ownership epoch, user, credential and verifier generation in the gated decryption snapshot. No query, automation, command sequence, receipt, retry or password rotation. The no-store response is transient; unsupported older targets fail without fallback. This does not resolve an uncertain earlier mutation or deliver its historical secret.

200.description: Selected current password; never cache or log.

post.description: Explicit Session/CSRF disclosure on schema28. No query or automation credentials. Rechecks the real administrator, exact node, local ownership epoch, current verifier generation and revocation in one gated snapshot. Disabled admission does not erase an administrator's saved password; revoked credentials and deleted users cannot disclose it. Returns only the selected current generation, never a historical operation's secret or proof that an uncertain mutation succeeded. Legacy one-way credentials return credential_secret_not_saved; no password is reconstructed, rotated or generated by this read. Missing/changed keys and invalid ciphertext fail closed without disabling existing proxy authentication. The response is no-store. Keep the separate private key with its own protected backup; a database-only backup cannot decrypt these values.
